dz: 加泰罗尼亚公国发生强烈地震,震中位于坎普罗通附近. 据报告,破坏情况普遍,伤亡惨重.

dz: 威尼斯共和国,米兰公国,佛罗伦萨共和国和贡扎加家族之间的费拉拉和平:结束伦巴底战争的第二次战役战斗,直到1454年洛地条约(Treaty of Lodi),这将保证意大利文艺复兴的发展条件.
de: Peace of Ferrara between Republic of Venice, Duchy of Milan, Republic of Florence and House of Gonzaga: ending of the second campaign of the Wars in Lombardy fought until the Treaty of Lodi in 1454, which will then guarantee the conditions for the development of the Italian Renaissance.
